finding: tools/stale_evidence_sweep.mjs loses the tail of its own report when it exits, and tools/fieldops/qa_record_control.mjs goes red as a result
mechanism: The sweep prints its whole table with console.log to stdout, then calls process.exit(2) on the unresolved/no-form branch. When stdout is a PIPE those writes are asynchronous, and process.exit() discards whatever is still queued. Two captures of the same unchanged sweep from the same tree returned 23,413 and 428,196 bytes of a 729,397-byte report -- non-deterministic truncation. The qa-record control plants its rows in a fixture repo that sorts LAST in the table, so the truncated tail is exactly the part it asserts on, and it reports 'no row emitted' for rows the sweep did emit.
whyItSurfacedHere: Volume. On main the report is 165 lines and flushes before the exit. This branch adds six runs of VB gate evidence -- 1,378 records that genuinely judge a subject, which the sweep is right to enumerate -- and the report crosses the flush point. Nothing in this PR touches tools/. The control was already fragile; the corpus grew past it.

whatIFixedOnMySide.after: 0 stale claims from VB evidence (34 total, of which tools/i4_link_liveness.py is pre-existing on main and 32 are one false positive, below)
whatIFixedOnMySide.how: VB evidence recorded subjects as bare basenames (SCI_G_W9B_....html) and as pack-relative paths, neither of which the sweep can resolve from the repo root. 2,062 of them rewritten to repo-relative paths -- 1,992 by unique basename across tracked files, 66 resolved against the record's own enclosing "pack" field, 4 pack-relative with a slash. None guessed: a basename carried by more than one tracked file was only rewritten where the record itself named the pack.

remainingFalsePositive: 32 rows report tools/render_installation_gate.js STALE. The evidence says _sownb/feb/tools/render_installation_gate.js, which exists; the sweep's PATH_NAMED regex /(?:tools|release|staging|Games)\/.../ is unanchored and matches the tail of that path. Not repaired here -- it is a regex in a shared tool, and a stale COUNT is a report, not a gate: main passes with a non-zero count.
proposedPatch: Flush before exiting. The naive one-line swap of process.exit(2) for process.exitCode = 2 is NOT correct -- execution then falls through into the REQUIRE_ROOTS/APPLY/DRY-RUN branches and the report changes (measured: 3,468 bytes and a different tail). The fix needs the terminal path to end without further output: either guard the subsequent blocks behind the same condition and set process.exitCode, or write the report with fs.writeSync(1, ...) so it is on the fd before exit. Whichever is chosen, the qa-record control should also stop reading a pipe: give it a file and read it back, so it cannot be starved by a report that grows.
notPushed: This is tools/fieldops/ and tools/, which this PR does not otherwise touch, and no fix for it exists upstream to port. Raised rather than widened.
